note: Forest Service campground in the Little Missouri National Grassland, 27 mi south of Medora near Amidon and White Butte, among badlands, columnar juniper and ponderosa pine. Shaded gravel pads; sites spacious and spread out. Southernmost Maah Daah Hey trailhead (west side), Juniper Spur trail on the south side. Roads in pass through private land. --Claude
